item.title: Independence Can Deliver a Kinder and Fairer Scotland Says SNP Candidate
item.description: The SNP has launched its 2026 campaign with calls for independence, as candidate Eilidh Munro argues Scotland can build a kinder, fairer and more prosperous future by choosing a different path from Westminster politics.The post Independence Can Deliver a Kinder and Fairer Scotland Says SNP Candidate appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Amber Snow Warnings Issued Across Highlands and Grampians
item.description: Amber snow warnings have been issued for the Highlands and Grampians as further heavy snowfall is forecast, with Police Scotland urging caution and communities warned to expect travel disruption, hazardous conditions and potential service interruptions.The post New Amber Snow Warnings Issued Across Highlands and Grampians appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Police Urge Caution as Amber Snow Warnings Remain in Force Across The Highlands
item.description: Amber snow warnings remain in force across the Highlands as heavy snowfall, ice and severe cold continue to disrupt travel, with Police Scotland and the Met Office warning communities to expect hazardous conditions and further wintry weather in the days ahead. The post Police Urge Caution as Amber Snow Warnings Remain in Force Across The Highlands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Community Invited to Shape Plans for Proposed Ardersier Masterplan
item.description: Residents in Ardersier are being invited to help shape proposals for a major housing development, as Highland Council consults on a Masterplan Consent Area designed to speed up delivery while keeping communities at the heart of planning decisions.The post Community Invited to Shape Plans for Proposed Ardersier Masterplan appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: How Road Gritting Works Across Moray During Winter Weather
item.description: Moray Council has explained how its winter road gritting operation works, from priority routes and weather monitoring to modern equipment and salt limits, as drivers are urged to stay cautious during snow and ice across the region.The post How Road Gritting Works Across Moray During Winter Weather appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Children First Urges Highland Families Struggling With Bills to Seek Support During Cold Snap
item.description: Children First is urging families in the Highlands struggling with bills and heating costs during the cold snap to contact its support line, as demand for help rises and parents face increasing pressure to keep children warm and well.The post Children First Urges Highland Families Struggling With Bills to Seek Support During Cold Snap appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Soaring Food Prices Push Shop Inflation Higher as SNP Attacks Labour Record
item.description: Rising food prices pushed UK shop inflation higher in December, adding pressure to household budgets as the SNP accuses Labour of failing families on the cost of living amid higher energy bills and growing concerns about affordability.The post Soaring Food Prices Push Shop Inflation Higher as SNP Attacks Labour Record appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: UK New Car Market Breaks Two Million as Electric Vehicles Surge
item.description: The UK new car market passed two million registrations in 2025 as electric vehicle sales surged, with almost one in four buyers going electric, while industry leaders warn the pace of change remains costly and government action is urgently needed.The post UK New Car Market Breaks Two Million as Electric Vehicles Surge appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland and Moray Communities Invited to Shape Lynx Reintroduction Plans
item.description: Communities across the Highlands and Moray are being invited to help shape plans for a possible lynx reintroduction, with public events launching this month to explore benefits, concerns and how people and wildlife could coexist.The post Highland and Moray Communities Invited to Shape Lynx Reintroduction Plans appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Consultation Launched on Raising Minimum Marriage Age in Scotland
item.description: Scotland is consulting on proposals to raise the minimum age of marriage and civil partnership from 16 to 18, alongside wider reforms to family law aimed at improving protection, fairness and transparency for young people and families.The post Consultation Launched on Raising Minimum Marriage Age in Scotland appeared first on The Highland Times.
